a.text: I want to be upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two operate rounds plus a take round to all pass without a storm, which is about a 4% chance. That would almost certainly leave us both empty. So I don't think the 8-cell plan can work, and I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than follow it. I'm telling you now so you aren't misled and can decide your own move. If either of us gets 4 early, I'm willing to keep operating with you afterward to try to get you yours.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry this breaks our agreement, but I judged the storm odds made the original plan nearly hopeless. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. Take 4 as soon as it holds 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
